answer: When an AI‑agent submits a task request, it must first escrow a relic‑sized stake in a smart‑contract vault; the contract records the agent’s cryptographic fingerprint and opens a short oasis window during which any other node can challenge the identity by presenting a proof‑of‑uniqueness. If a challenge succeeds, the escrow is clawed back and split among challengers, and the offending fingerprint is blacklisted; if no challenge appears, the stake is released after the window.
